Name: Pekah, King of Israel
Summary: Pekah, son of Remaliah, seized the throne by murder, allied with Rezin of Syria against Ahaz, and lost Israel's northern cities to Tiglath-pileser before Hoshea slew him.
KeyStory: Pekah allies with Rezin and loses the north to Assyria.
RelatedPeople: Pekahiah, King of Israel; Rezin, King of Syria; Ahaz, King of Judah; Tiglath-Pileser, King of Assyria; Remaliah, Father of Pekah; Hoshea, King of Israel; Isaiah
LifeLesson: An alliance against God's people invites the very empire it fears.
